curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What will his fellow graduate student make of Herbert West’s clandestine work on re-animating corpses?
curatedMovie.description: At Miskatonic University, scientist Herbert West shares his clandestine morgue research on re-animating fresh corpses with another graduate student.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful, and darkly comic sci-fi horror built for an entertaining night with friends.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Its comedy-horror science-fiction premise follows forbidden university research as West reveals it to a fellow student.
